rules.title: Inspiration (GM note)
rules.summary: A simple reward the GM hands out for playing a character's personality, ideals, bonds or flaws well. A character either has inspiration or not; spending it gives advantage on one attack roll, saving throw or ability check. Track it on the sheet or with the Inspiration tracker.

rules.title: Calling for checks (GM advice)
rules.summary: Ask for a roll only when the result is uncertain and matters. Name the ability and skill, set the DC (10 easy, 15 medium, 20 hard), and decide before the roll what failure costs. The play guide in table mode lists cues for every skill.

rules.title: Building encounters (GM advice)
rules.summary: The encounter generator is a starting point, not a balance formula: it picks SRD monsters whose challenge rating suits the party's level band and the terrain. Adjust numbers to the party's size and resources, and give every fight a reason, a place that matters and a way out.

rules.title: Multiclassing
rules.summary:
A summary of the SRD 5.1's multiclassing rules, as the character builder applies them.

**Prerequisites.** To take a level in a new class you need a score of 13 in its prime ability, and in your current classes' too: Barbarian Strength; Bard Charisma; Cleric Wisdom; Druid Wisdom; Fighter Strength or Dexterity; Monk Dexterity and Wisdom; Paladin Strength and Charisma; Ranger Dexterity and Wisdom; Rogue Dexterity; Sorcerer Charisma; Warlock Charisma; Wizard Intelligence.

**Proficiencies.** A new class gives only some of its starting proficiencies: Barbarian shields, simple and martial weapons; Bard light armor, one skill, one musical instrument; Cleric and Druid light and medium armor, shields; Fighter, Paladin and Ranger light and medium armor, shields, simple and martial weapons (a ranger also one skill from its list); Monk simple weapons and shortswords; Rogue light armor, one skill from its list, thieves' tools; Warlock light armor and simple weapons; Sorcerer and Wizard none.

**Hit points and dice.** Only your first class gives its full hit die at 1st level; each later level adds that class's die (or its average) and your Constitution modifier. Your proficiency bonus follows your total character level.

**Spell slots.** With the Spellcasting feature from more than one class, add your bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer and wizard levels, half your paladin and ranger levels (rounded down), and read your slots from the Multiclass Spellcaster table (the same as a full caster's). Pact Magic slots stay separate. Spells known and prepared are counted per class.

rules.title: Ability scores at character creation
rules.cite: SRD 5.2 — Character Creation: Determine Ability Scores
rules.summary:
The three ways the SRD 5.2 gives to determine ability scores, as the builder offers them.

- **Standard array:** 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8, each assigned to one ability.
- **Random generation:** roll four d6 and add the highest three, six times, then assign the totals.
- **Point cost:** 27 points; every score starts at 8 and costs 8: 0, 9: 1, 10: 2, 11: 3, 12: 4, 13: 5, 14: 7, 15: 9.

Then apply the increases your background (SRD 5.2) or race (SRD 5.1) gives; no score can go above 20.

result.name: Ossuary
result.readAloud: Skulls and long bones are stacked to the ceiling in neat, patient rows.

result.name: Embalming room
result.readAloud: A stone slab with blood gutters, and shelves of jars whose wax seals are broken.

result.name: Mourners' chapel
result.readAloud: Benches face a cracked altar. Someone left fresh candles here, not long ago.

result.name: Burial niches
result.readAloud: The walls are honeycombed with niches, each holding a shrouded shape.

result.name: Knight's tomb
result.readAloud: A stone knight lies on the lid of a sarcophagus, sword clasped to its chest.

result.name: Grave-goods store
result.readAloud: Chests and urns are heaped against the walls, most of them already pried open.

result.name: Collapsed vault
result.readAloud: Half the ceiling has come down; roots hang through the gap like reaching hands.

result.name: Priest's cell
result.readAloud: A narrow cot, a prayer rope, and a ledger of names written in a careful hand.

result.name: Hall of statues
result.readAloud: Robed statues line both walls, faces worn smooth, every one turned toward the door.

result.name: Charnel pit
result.readAloud: A railing guards a pit whose bottom you cannot see. The air rising from it is cold.

result.name: Family vault
result.readAloud: Name plaques line the walls: three generations of one family, the last plaque left blank.

result.name: Flooded crypt
result.readAloud: Black water stands knee-deep, and coffin lids float in it like rafts.

result.name: Founder's burial chamber
result.readAloud: A great sarcophagus stands on a dais, its lid carved with a face that is almost smiling.

result.name: Necromancer's sanctum
result.readAloud: Candles burn in a ring of chalk symbols around a table fitted with leather straps.

result.name: The sealed tomb
result.readAloud: Iron bands and wax seals cover this side of the door. Whoever sealed it meant to keep something in.

result.name: Reliquary
result.readAloud: Gold glints in an alcove behind a screen of bones wired together into a lattice.

result.readAloud: A small chapel with its altar pushed aside, uncovering steps down into the dark.

result.name: Barrow mouth
result.readAloud: A low stone doorway, its lintel carved with weathered warnings.

result.name: Dripping grotto
result.readAloud: Water drips from a forest of stalactites into shallow pools.

result.name: Bat roost
result.readAloud: The ceiling rustles. Droppings crust the floor ankle-deep.

result.name: Fungus garden
result.readAloud: Pale mushrooms as tall as a child glow a faint blue.

result.name: Bone midden
result.readAloud: Gnawed bones, broken weapons and torn packs: something eats here.

result.name: Underground stream
result.readAloud: A fast black stream cuts across the cave; the far bank is a long step away.

result.name: Crystal hollow
result.readAloud: Quartz glitters in every wall, throwing your light back at you a hundred times.

result.name: Rockfall
result.readAloud: A slope of fallen boulders. Crossing it means picking a careful way.

result.name: Sleeping chamber
result.readAloud: Nests of moss and hide line the walls. They are still warm.

result.name: Echoing cavern
result.readAloud: Every footstep comes back three times. The roof is lost in the dark.

result.name: Narrow squeeze
result.readAloud: The walls close in until you must turn sideways to pass.

result.name: Old campsite
result.readAloud: A ring of stones, cold ashes and a name carved in the rock: someone sheltered here long ago.

result.name: Chasm edge
result.readAloud: The floor ends at a crack too deep to see the bottom of. A draught moans out of it.

result.name: Beast's den
result.readAloud: The stench hits first. Bones crunch underfoot, and two eyes catch your light.

result.name: Hoard cave
result.readAloud: Coins and plunder are heaped in a natural basin, polished smooth by something that sleeps on them.

result.name: Shrine of the deep
result.readAloud: A crude idol of piled stones stands over a still pool, hung with offerings.

result.name: Chief's hall
result.readAloud: A wide cavern with a throne of lashed timber and furs at its far end.

result.name: Sinkhole

result.name: Waterfall cave
result.readAloud: Behind a curtain of falling water, a wet ledge leads into the hill.

result.name: Great hall
result.readAloud: Long tables, a cold hearth wide enough to stand in, and banners rotted to rags.

result.name: Kitchen
result.readAloud: Copper pots on hooks, a bread oven, and a chopping block scored with a thousand cuts.

result.name: Barracks

result.name: Armoury

result.name: Chapel

result.name: Solar

result.name: Storeroom

result.name: Guardroom
result.readAloud: A table with a dice cup and a half-finished game, abandoned in a hurry.

result.name: Stables
result.readAloud: Stalls of mouldy straw; the tack still hangs on its pegs.

result.name: Well room

result.name: Library

result.readAloud: Writing desks with dry inkwells; a half-copied text lies open.

result.name: Bell room
result.readAloud: A bell rope hangs from a hole in the ceiling. The bell is gone.

result.name: Reliquary chapel
result.readAloud: Glass cases, all smashed, and one small box no one noticed.

result.name: Pilgrims' dormitory
result.readAloud: Straw pallets in rows, and prayers scratched into the wall.

result.name: Collapsed aisle
result.readAloud: The roof has fallen in. Sunlight and rain come through the hole.

result.name: Chapter house
result.readAloud: A ring of stone seats facing a lectern carved like an eagle.

result.name: Ossuary chapel
result.readAloud: Bones arranged into patterns on every wall and across the ceiling.

result.name: Treasury of offerings
result.readAloud: Alms boxes broken open; a few coins still lie in the corners.

result.name: Crypt stair
result.readAloud: A stair spirals down beneath a slab that has been moved aside.

result.name: Sanctum
result.readAloud: The high altar stands under a broken dome. Something waits beside it.

result.name: Desecrated altar
result.readAloud: The altar has been overturned and a new idol raised in its place.

result.name: Oracle's hall
result.readAloud: A cracked tripod over a fissure that breathes warm, sweet air.

result.name: Saint's tomb
result.readAloud: A golden casket on a plinth, guarded by statues holding real swords.

result.name: Narthex
result.readAloud: A porch of fallen columns, and great doors standing half open.

result.name: Pilgrims' porch
result.readAloud: A wide porch worn smooth by a thousand knees.

result.name: West front
result.readAloud: A ruined façade of saints with their faces knocked off, over a gaping doorway.

result.name: Nave
result.readAloud: Rows of broken pews march toward the far end, where the light falls.

result.name: Great nave
result.readAloud: Pillars like a stone forest hold up a roof of painted stars, flaking away.

result.name: Burnt nave
result.readAloud: Half the pews are ash. Birds nest in the blackened rafters.

result.name: Ore face
result.readAloud: Pick marks score the rock, and a vein of ore glints in your light.

result.name: Cart depot
result.readAloud: Ore carts on rusted rails, one of them tipped on its side.

result.name: Timbered gallery
result.readAloud: Old props hold up the roof, some of them cracked and bowing.

result.name: Miners' shrine
result.readAloud: A little shrine to the earth, with candle stubs and a lucky pick.

result.name: Flooded working
result.readAloud: The lower end of this cut is under cold, still water.

result.name: Collapsed stope
result.readAloud: A cave-in has left a heap of rubble and a dark gap above it.

result.name: Bunk room
result.readAloud: Wooden bunks and a stove; someone's boots still stand by the door.

result.name: Powder store
result.readAloud: Kegs marked with warning signs, stacked well away from the lamps.

result.name: Winch room
result.readAloud: A great winch over a shaft that drops away into darkness.

result.name: Smelting hall
result.readAloud: A cold furnace, slag heaps, and moulds for ingots.

result.name: Foreman's office
result.readAloud: A desk, a tally board, and a strongbox bolted to the floor.

result.name: Abandoned drift
result.readAloud: This tunnel was dug and then given up; the rails end in bare rock.

result.name: The deep vein
result.readAloud: The tunnel opens into a cavern glittering with untouched ore, and something guarding it.

result.name: Breakthrough
result.readAloud: The miners broke into a natural cave here, and stopped digging very suddenly.

result.name: Overseer's hold
result.readAloud: A fortified chamber with an iron door and arrow slits facing the tunnel.

result.name: Forgotten forge
result.readAloud: An ancient forge, older than the mine, its fire somehow still glowing.

result.name: Adit
result.readAloud: A timbered tunnel mouth in the hillside, with rails running in.

result.name: Pit bottom
result.readAloud: The bottom of the shaft: a ladder up to daylight and a landing of rotten planks.

result.name: Spoil-heap cut
result.readAloud: A narrow cut behind the spoil heaps, an old way in.

tables.name: Dungeon traps (SRD sample traps)
tables.notes: The SRD 5.1's sample traps with their own DCs and damage. Scale them for the party with the Trap Save DCs and Damage Severity by Level tables (the dungeon key does).

result.name: Collapsing roof
result.spot: Trip wire: spot it with DC 10; disable it with thieves' tools, DC 15 Dexterity.
result.effect: The ceiling falls: DC 15 Dexterity save, 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage, half as much on a success; the floor becomes difficult terrain.

result.name: Falling net
result.spot: Trip wire and net: spot them with DC 10; break the wire with thieves' tools, DC 15 Dexterity.
result.effect: A 10-foot-square net: those under it are restrained, and knocked prone on a failed DC 10 Strength save; a DC 10 Strength check frees one (the net has AC 10 and 20 hit points).

result.name: Fire-breathing statue
result.spot: Pressure plate and scorch marks: spot them with DC 15; an iron spike under the plate stops it.
result.effect: A 30-foot cone of fire: DC 13 Dexterity save, 22 (4d10) fire damage, half as much on a success; dispel magic (DC 13) destroys the trap.

result.name: Simple pit
result.spot: A covered pit: spot it with DC 10.
result.effect: A 10-foot fall: 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet.

result.name: Hidden pit
result.spot: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) notices the untrodden floor; DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) confirms the cover.
result.effect: A fall of 10 or 20 feet; a spike wedged under the cover makes it safe.

result.name: Locking pit
result.spot: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) notices the untrodden floor; DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) confirms the cover.
result.effect: A fall of 10 or 20 feet, and the cover snaps shut: DC 20 Strength to pry it open, or DC 15 Dexterity with thieves' tools from inside.

result.name: Spiked pit
result.spot: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) notices the untrodden floor; DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) confirms the cover.
result.effect: A fall of 10 or 20 feet onto spikes: 11 (2d10) piercing damage more; poisoned spikes add a DC 13 Constitution save, 22 (4d10) poison damage, half as much on a success.

result.name: Poison darts
result.spot: Dart holes: spot them with DC 15, or find the pressure plate with DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation).
result.effect: Four darts, each +8 to hit a random creature within 10 feet: 2 (1d4) piercing damage and a DC 15 Constitution save, 11 (2d10) poison damage, half as much on a success.

result.name: Poison needle
result.spot: In a lock: DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) notices it; thieves' tools and DC 15 Dexterity disarm it.
result.effect: 1 piercing and 11 (2d10) poison damage, and a DC 15 Constitution save or poisoned for 1 hour.

result.name: Rolling sphere
result.spot: Pressure plate and trapdoor: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) spots them; DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) reads the stonework.
result.effect: A 10-foot stone sphere rolls 60 feet a turn (initiative +8): DC 15 Dexterity save or 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage and prone; a DC 20 Strength check slows it by 15 feet.
